research.question: Is any Indian company publicly documented as a NavisLabs customer, partner, design partner or authorized user of Navis?
searches: "NavisLabs" OR "Navis Labs" customer OR partner OR "design partner" India (web search)
navis-labs-website source, read only: grep for trusted by / design partner / customers / testimonial / case study
findings: navislabs.in names no customer, partner, design partner, logo wall or testimonial; its demos use the placeholders 'Acme Corp' and 'Northwind Systems'.
Website source (read only): app/company/page.tsx — 'Building with selected design partners.' / 'NavisLabs is being deployed with a small group of design partners'; no names.
Web results for 'Navis' partners concern unrelated companies (Navis terminal-operations software, Navis Clinical Laboratories, Navi Technologies) — not NavisLabs.
research.conclusion: No authorized real customer exists in any public or provided source. No real company is shown as a customer.

decision: Option A + B: NavisLabs (real, authorized) is the organization using its own products; the customer is a clearly fictional Indian-context company, Kaveri Freightworks (Bengaluru logistics), named as fictional in the end-card disclosure.
